title: nazm.repository-map/1
description: The repository context map, from `nazm repo --map --json` and the `nazm-mcp` tool `nazm.repository_map`: every entity of the repository that has a durable identity — Cargo packages and targets, Nazm source roots, compilation roots, modules and durable definitions, documents, published schemas and mutation profiles — with its authority, its parent, its structural relationships and how to retrieve more, and never a source body or a section's text. Each relationship is read from a named authority: Cargo manifests, the compiler, the documentation corpus (N32) or the mutation catalogue. Entities another subsystem enumerates (documentation sections, mutations, catalogue tests, diagnostics) are counted in `delegated` with the answer that lists them; what has no durable identity is named in `omitted`. `unavailable` when an input cannot be read or the map does not validate — never a map with a broken or duplicate entity.

state.description: BLAKE3 over every input the map is built from, each by its repository-relative path and exact bytes: the documentation corpus's state, every Cargo manifest and the targets Cargo would find, the mutation catalogue, every published schema and every `.nz` file directly in a source root. No absolute path, time, process or commit.

authority.description: The authority every entity of the kind is read from; a document carries its own.

identity.description: What the kind's ids are made of.

entities.description: In canonical order: by kind, in `classes` order, then by id in byte order. Each id once.

id.description: `kind:authority-id` — `package:nazm-docs`, `target:nazm-docs:test:corpus`, `sources:compiler`, `root:compiler:emit.nz`, `module:compiler:analyse.nz`, `def:compiler:analyse.nz::fn check` (a durable definition key under a source root), `doc:spec` (N32's document id), `schema:nazm.context/1`, `profile:checker`. Never a path, line, offset, time or commit.

detail.description: A target's Cargo kind (`lib`, `bin`, `test`, `bench`, `example`), a definition's kind (`function`, `record`, `enum`), or whether a compilation is `complete` or `incomplete` — needed syntax recovery or lacks a module, so its definitions are not mapped.

authority.description: A document's N32 authority. A `goal` is aspiration and `planning` a plan: never evidence of what exists.

source.description: Where it is, from the repository root. A location, never its identity.

relations.description: By kind, then target; each once.

kind.description: `depends_on`, `dev_depends_on`: a Cargo dependency on another member. `documented_by`: a section the package's `[package.metadata.nazm] docs` or the source root's manifest row names. `includes`: a module the compilation loaded. `observed_by`, `covers`: a profile's targets and the package or source root its `owns` names, from the mutation catalogue.

target.description: An entity of this map, or for `documented_by` an N32 section id prefixed `doc:`.

retrieval.description: The existing answer that holds more, and the arguments of the command or tool that gives it.

root.description: A compilation root, from the repository root.

file.description: Relative to the compilation's source root.
